full_judgment: 5. As it appears the trial Court, duly considering of the evidence on record, held that the plaintiffs proved absolute right, title and possession of Ershadullah, their predecessor, in the suit property by producing rent receipts given by the office of Jominders which have been duly marked as exhibits and the defendant could not prove their case by producing any admissible document/papers, the appellate Court considering the materials on record duly affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court. The High Court Division, after hearing, discharged the Rule holding Irshadulah, the predecessor of the plaintiffs took pattan of the said property from the Zamindar on payment of salami and rents out of his independents income and the plaintiffs sold 52 decimals of land conceding the pattan in question and the plaintiffs proved their right, title and possession over 2.95½ decimals of land by paying rents and taxes in their own names after acquiring the same, by pattan and the plaintiffs proved the correctness of pattan obtained by Irshadullah by the staff of Jaminders who is a man aged about 72 years and thus proved the right, title and possession in of the plaintiffs the suit land.
